answer: Only branches in separate clusters can license a charter, and each signature takes one jade, locked at the mint and forfeit if the log shows one maker with two charters from the same branch. A zephyr carries one charter only, and every voyage it runs is written into that log, which is where duplicates collide. A maker must gather one more signature than the charters it already holds, and no branch signs it twice: an honest newcomer needs one branch and one jade, while an operator's thousandth head needs a thousand untouched branches and a thousand jade.
